name: phase-5b-hosted-rag-quality
description: Synthetic support corpus for validating the hosted AskWell Lite RAG workflow without touching production data.

articles.title: Trial policy
articles.content: AskWell offers a 14 day trial. A payment card is not required during the trial. Trial workspaces include one admin seat, the hosted support widget, and up to 100 demo conversations.

articles.title: Install the hosted widget
articles.content: To install the customer support widget, copy the script from the Install page and paste it before the closing body tag on your website. Hosted mode answers from indexed knowledge documents and returns citations.

articles.title: Plan limits
articles.content: The Free plan includes one workspace, one admin, and 100 conversations. The Growth plan includes five seats, 1000 conversations, and custom widget branding.

articles.title: Cancel and export
articles.content: Workspace owners can export conversations from the Inbox before cancelling. To cancel, open billing settings, choose Cancel plan, and confirm the change.

articles.title: Password recovery
articles.content: If an admin forgets their password, use the password reset link on the sign-in page. The reset email expires after 30 minutes.

articles.title: Data retention
articles.content: Deleted documents are removed from the index with their chunks and embeddings. Exported workspace JSON files are created locally by the browser and are not uploaded by AskWell Lite.

articles.title: Invoices and tax details
articles.content: Invoices are available from billing settings. Team admins can add tax details and billing email recipients before downloading an invoice.

articles.title: Escalation policy
articles.content: Urgent billing incidents should be escalated through the support inbox. A human support owner should respond within one business day.
